days.label: Friday
days.text: Friday is the day to be outside. Expect mostly sunny skies, a high near 71 and a light north wind, with no rain at all and a mild evening that is still in the mid 60s at 7. A nor'easter passes by this weekend and we only catch its outer fringes, so Saturday turns cloudy and breezy with a high near 68, north gusts up to 25 mph and a chance of showers after 8 PM. Sunday is the cooler, damper day, with a high near 65 and a 40% chance of showers from the morning on, and rain amounts look light. Track it all week, with patio, swim, and sunset scores, at Burlington Right Now .

days.label: Friday
days.text: Friday gets going early for climbers, with the Vermont Climbing Festival opening its three day run at Farr's Field in Waterbury, clinics at 9 and a bluegrass jam and campfire story hour in the evening. It is also the last day to drop off gear for the Patagonia Gear Swap on College Street before the shopping days Saturday and Sunday. At 2 UVM President Marlene Tromp talks about higher education in 2026 at the EEE lecture series at Faith United Methodist Church in South Burlington. From 5 to 7 the BCA Center opens Barbershop: The Art of Queer Failure , where artist Ace Lehner gives haircuts first come, first served, and each person getting a cut commits to an act of queer world making before it grows out. The Alliance Française's French Social Hour runs 5:30 to 7 at the Hilton Garden Inn, and in Shelburne, Russell Lord's lecture on how Norman Rockwell used photography kicks off Rockwell Day at 5:30. Magic players can try the new set early at the prerelease at Old Town Cafe & Comics in Williston, capped at 30 players.

days.label: Friday
days.text: Friday night stacks up around 7. Cricket Blue releases its new album, Sweet Animal, with an 11 piece orchestra at the First Unitarian church at the top of Church Street, doors at 6:30 and Lily Talmers opening. Novelist Daniel Mason talks about his new book Country People at Shelburne Town Hall at 7, his only Vermont tour stop ($35 with a copy of the book). Juno winner Sophie Buddle plays Vermont Comedy Club at 7, VTIFF screens Barbara Forever , a documentary about experimental filmmaker Barbara Hammer, at 7, local comedians perform the scripted sitcom Pet Store live at Off Center at 7, and the Queen City Ghostwalk leaves the Democracy Sculpture at 7 for theater ghosts, smugglers and more. At 7:30 the UVM Lane Series brings Malian kora master Ballaké Sissoko with Piers Faccini to the Recital Hall, and Vermont Swings has a live band swing dance with The Mighty Flea Circus at North Star Community Hall, with a free beginner lesson at 7 and music at 7:30. Tophouse , a rock band that married old fashioned bluegrass, has doors at 7:30 at Higher Ground.

days.label: Saturday
days.text: Saturday starts with us. BTown Coffee Club [MEETUP] is at Zero Gravity at 10, so come find us. Earlier birds have plenty going on. Old Spokes Home's Fall Fundo rolls out at 8 with four ride lengths from 15 to 100 kilometers, the Burlington Farmers Market runs 9 to 2 at 345 Pine Street, and the Burlington Vintage Market sets up next door at Barge Canal Market. Birders can join a free guided walk at Wheeler Nature Park at 9 during peak fall migration, and the Friendly Tabletop Gamers hold a Board Game Brunch [MEETUP] at Old Town Cafe & Comics in Williston from 9 to noon. At 10 the Patagonia Gear Swap opens for shopping through Sunday, the Vermont Anime and Gaming Expo fills Hotel Champlain until 6 with vendors, voice actor guests and a cosplay contest, and a clinic on Dorset Street in South Burlington offers donation ear acupuncture .

days.label: Saturday
days.text: Saturday night, Williston's Movie in the Park shows Hoppers at Village Community Park at 7 for free, so bring blankets and chairs. Shelburne Farms leads a full moon forest bathing walk from 7 to 9 ($35), and the Vermont Symphonic Winds play St. Mike's at 7 with Copland's Lincoln Portrait and a new piece by Essex native Holden Friesel. Higher Ground has Vermont duo Dwight + Nicole for a hometown show with doors at 7, then Donna the Buffalo at 8. Dad Guild gathers dads around a fire at Rock Point at 8, Boston's The Sheila Divine hits the Monkey House stage at 8:15, and Standing Stone in Winooski hosts Queeraoke with Lizzie Murderz .

days.label: Sunday
days.text: Sunday starts early for runners. The Shelburne Farms 5K goes off at 8, capped at 200 runners, and registration closes tonight at 11:59 with only a handful of spots left. Local Motion's Day Tripper($230) leaves at 8:15 for a guided ride up the Island Line Trail and across the Bike Ferry to South Hero, with lunch at Snow Farm Vineyard, and the Chase Away 5K at Veterans Memorial Park at 9 raises money for canine cancer research. From 10 to 2, the Winooski Farmers Market hosts Youth Vendor Day , with sellers 17 and under, performers and an instrument petting zoo, and Soda Plant Sundays fills the Soda Plant on Pine Street with local artists, vintage, food and free live music. The Forever 38 group hikes Mount Philo [MEETUP] at 11.
